archetypes.name: scope-audit
archetypes.rationale: The diff modifies .claude/skills/release/SKILL.md to add an origin/main rebase-sync step that is entirely absent from the plan, warranting targeted review of this out-of-scope addition.
archetypes.prompt_body: The plan covers only the design-log-publish pipeline (five specific files); it does not mention .claude/skills/release/SKILL.md at all. The diff adds a new Step 1 sync block to the release skill that invokes rebase-push.sh with --no-push --base-remote origin --base-ref main. Investigate whether rebase-push.sh actually supports that flag combination, and whether the three-branch error-handling logic (exit 0 / exit 1 for conflicts / other-non-zero) is complete and correct. Check whether the rebase step should be guarded by --dry-run (the plan notes dry-run may run with a dirty tree, but the sync step runs unconditionally including on --dry-run). Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: doc-consistency
archetypes.rationale: lib-design-round-artifacts.md had an internal contradiction between its Include basenames list and its manifests-excluded policy; verify the update fully resolves it and that all edit-in-sync obligations are met.
archetypes.prompt_body: scripts/lib-design-round-artifacts.md previously listed panel-manifest.ndjson and round-meta.json in the top-level Include basenames section while the bottom section stated manifests are excluded — a direct contradiction. Verify the diff removes both from the include list and that no remaining prose re-introduces the contradiction. Check that the edit-in-sync rule (requiring atomic updates across lib-design-round-artifacts.md, design-log-publish.md, lib-design-round-artifacts.sh, plan-review-loop.md if snapshot behavior is described, and test-lib-design-round-artifacts.sh) is fully satisfied by this diff. Also verify that the new assert_excluded calls in test-lib-design-round-artifacts.sh test the correct function — the actual bug fix lives in design_artifact_excluded() in design-log-publish.sh, while those assertions likely exercise design_round_artifact_included() in lib-design-round-artifacts.sh, leaving the patched exclude path untested. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
